node.title: Re: SerialPort issues under Windows 10
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Based on my testing, the issue is that you need to do $port->write_settings or die "write_settings: $^E"; after setting the parameters.

The next issue I had was that [mod://Win32::SerialPort]'s ->read appears to be behaving non-blocking (I unfortunately don't have enough time to investigate further at the moment see reply). See its documentation for a few blocking methods you can try, or you can use the tied filehandle interface to be able to use Perl's [doc://readline] and [doc://read] - if I wanted blocking I/O, the latter is what I would do as I find the filehandle interface more familiar.

Note you should [id://111088]!
